Implemented a restoration-mode solver in [solve.py](/app/submissions/solve.py), kept the mathematical model in [model.md](/app/submissions/model.md), and produced [solution.csv](/app/submissions/solution.csv) plus [solve_log.md](/app/submissions/solve_log.md).

The exact integrated model had timed out earlier with no incumbent, so I replaced the runtime path with a smaller PySCIPOpt Phase-I restoration solve around a fixed low-volume feasible policy. The restoration LP solved to `theta = 0`, wrote a 97-line artifact, and the script’s independent public-data audit passed for acceptance floors, scenario service, timing, battery, charging taper/grid, pads, parking, corridor limits, noise, service windows, reserve checkpoints, and group spreads.
